message.content:
This editorial illustration features three male figures and a large structure against a light blue background. At the top, large red text reads "TEMPO" above the smaller line "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU." Black text headlines include "Ancaman Baru Undang-Undang ITE H.70" and "Penetrasi Kongsi GoTo dan TikTok H.80." A barcode, QR code, and price information are positioned in the upper right.

Centrally, the text "ANGAN-ANGAN SATU PUTARAN" is written in bold black capital letters. Below it, a paragraph mentions "Presiden Jokowi," "Prabowo Subianto-Gibran Rakabuming Raka," and "H.30."

On the left, a thin man in a long-sleeved white shirt and dark trousers operates a manual air pump. He has a somber expression. The pump's black hose connects to the base of a tall, white, crumpled, box-like structure that appears to be made of flexible material. This structure features a gray square window and four small circular holes on its side. Standing atop this structure is an exceptionally large, spherical man in a white shirt, smiling with closed eyes. Behind him, another thin man in a white shirt raises a fist in the air. The scene is set on a flat, light-colored surface.
